introduction: Georgia unemployment claims can be filed through the MyUI Claimant Portal or a GDOL career center. After applying, weekly benefit certification and work-search reporting remain separate tasks.

sections.who: GDOL reviews qualifying work history, the circumstances of job loss or reduced hours and continuing availability for work. A person working reduced hours may be considered; the agency determines the claim.
sections.get: Unemployment insurance provides temporary income for approved claimants. A payment requires the ongoing eligibility and certification process, not just an initial application.
sections.docs:

  • Employment dates and employer contact details for the past 18 months.
  • An available separation notice; applicable military, federal-employment or work-authorization records.
  • Banking details if choosing direct deposit.
sections.apply:
1. File or reopen the claim

    Start from GDOL’s regular UI page and follow the MyUI link, or request help at a career center.

  2. Answer review questions

    Keep confirmations and respond to identity, wage or separation questions.

  3. Complete weekly tasks

    Follow the handbook’s benefit-certification and work-search instructions. Submitting a search record is not the same as certifying for payment.
sections.after: Check MyUI messages and report earnings accurately when claiming a week. Read the decision for review or appeal instructions if wages or eligibility are disputed.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using GDOL regular UI eligibility and filing, UI claimant handbook, Claim options. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: GDOL lists reduced-hours circumstances as a possible claim route; eligibility still must be assessed.
Can I file without a personal computer?
GDOL career centers offer filing assistance and resource computers.
Does a work-search record request my payment?
No. The current claimant handbook describes work-search reporting and weekly certification as separate processes.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
